help.script.title: Script
help.script.body:
Write it in the template: cast / scene / shot N.
"Hand to the board" splits on [shot N] and extracts cast, scenes and props.
Edit the script and click it again to rebuild the shots.
help.board.title: Storyboard
help.board.body:
Shows how many shots were cut and what was recognised.
The recognised items become consistency references.
Re-splitting rebuilds the workbenches and resets their wires.
help.assets.title: Shared assets
help.assets.body:
Cast, scenes and props used by the whole film.
"Swap image" uploads a portrait — only assets with an image become references.
Shots inherit whoever they mention, which is what keeps faces stable.
help.params.title: Generation settings
help.params.body:
Resolution, sampling, LoRA and prompt reinforcement live here.
These apply to the whole film and need no wiring: the graph has a single global
parameter node, so per-shot settings are not possible.
Only what you changed is sent; the rest keeps the template defaults.
Subtitles on also suppresses the model drawing dialogue, or you get two captions.
help.shot.title: Shot workbench
help.shot.body:
One shot is one job, and a run can be resumed.
Generating again keeps every take; flip through them with ‹ ›.
Only the take you adopt goes into the film.
help.final.title: Final cut
help.final.body:
"Resume the N missing shots" renders shot by shot and survives a refresh.
"Join the N finished shots" only concatenates, in seconds.
Export defaults to vertical; once there is a film you can open it in the editor.
help.canvas.title: Canvas controls
help.canvas.body:
Right-drag or middle-drag pans, the wheel pans too, ctrl+wheel zooms.
Drag a node header to move it, drag the right dot to wire it.
Drag empty space to select, Delete removes, Esc clears, ctrl+A takes all.
Double-click empty space to fit everything; Shift+1 does the same.
